messages:
From: John Doe <john@openlib.org>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration

Hi Camila,

I signed up via the self-serve flow this morning (OpenLib) and started poking around. We're evaluating options to index PRs and issue threads from our public GitHub org and would love to understand how Redwood deals with repository metadata. Specifically: can we map PR/issue metadata (labels, author, commit refs) into embeddings so we can filter and surface by those attributes?

Also, do you have a SOC 2 report or security questionnaire we can review? Would love to set up a short demo — I'm available next week Monday or Wednesday afternoon PST.

Thanks,
John
John Doe
Senior Platform Engineer, OpenLib
john@openlib.org

Attachment: openlib-signup-record.csv (1 KB CSV stub)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: John Doe <john@openlib.org>
Date: 2027-06-20T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration

Hi John — thanks for signing up and for the clear questions. Happy to walk through how teams typically ingest GitHub data and how metadata can be preserved and surfaced in embeddings. Short answers: yes — you can include PR/issue fields as attributes to the document you index, and our tooling lets you store and query metadata alongside embeddings for filtering/reranking. We'll cover details in the demo.

Would 30 minutes next week work? I can do:
- Mon 2027-06-21 at 2:00 PM PST
- Mon 2027-06-21 at 4:00 PM PST
- Wed 2027-06-23 at 11:00 AM PST

If none of those work, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/camila-redwood/30

I'm attaching a short product brief and a redacted SOC 2 summary; Alex (solutions engineer) can join the call if you'd like a deeper technical walkthrough.

Best,
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-product-brief.pdf (2 pages), redwood-soc2-redacted.pdf (redacted summary)

From: John Doe <john@openlib.org>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-20T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration

Thanks Camila — that sounds good. Couple of follow-ups before we lock the time: can you confirm whether we can preserve PR-level metadata as top-level fields for filtering at query time (e.g., label:security, author:bot-account)? Also curious if Redwood supports mapping commit SHAs to canonical document ids to maintain traceability.

Either Mon afternoon works for me; preference for Wed if it's possible. And yes, we'd like to review SOC2 — thanks for the redacted summary.

John

Looping in Alex from Solutions so we can cover the mapping/traceability questions and possible ingestion patterns. Alex — OpenLib (John) is evaluating indexing PRs/issues from a public GitHub org and wants to understand metadata preservation, mapping commit SHAs, and filtering by labels/authors.

John — Alex can speak through two common approaches: 1) store flattened metadata fields with each document so you can filter at query time, and 2) keep a separate metadata index that maps SHAs to canonical document ids if you need strict traceability for audits. We'll show both in the demo and share sample ingestion configs.

Proposed demo slots (all PST):
- Wed 2027-06-23 11:00 AM (preferred)

Camila Reyes
